title: Proposition 1: Authorizes Bonds for Housing Affordability Programs
summary: Legislative statute placed on the ballot by the Legislature. Authorizes state general obligation bonds to fund housing affordability programs.
yes_meaning: The state may sell general obligation bonds to fund housing affordability programs.
no_meaning: No such housing bonds are authorized.

title: Proposition 2: Increases State's Rainy Day Fund
summary: Legislative constitutional amendment. Increases required deposits into the state's Budget Stabilization Account ("rainy day fund").
yes_meaning: Increases the required deposits into the state's rainy day reserve fund.
no_meaning: Keeps the current rainy day fund deposit rules.

title: Proposition 3: Permanent Funding for Schools and Health Care by Extending Existing Tax on High Incomes
summary: Initiative constitutional amendment. Makes permanent the existing personal income tax surcharge on high incomes and dedicates the revenue to schools and health care.
yes_meaning: Makes the existing high-income tax permanent and dedicates the revenue to schools and health care.
no_meaning: The existing high-income tax expires as currently scheduled.

title: Proposition 4: Repeals Prohibition Against Public Funding of Election Campaigns
summary: Legislative statute. Repeals the state ban on public funding of political campaigns.
yes_meaning: Repeals the ban, allowing public campaign financing programs.
no_meaning: Keeps the ban on public funding of political campaigns.

title: Proposition 5: Changes Recall Election Process for Statewide Officers
summary: Legislative constitutional amendment. Changes the process and timing for recall elections of statewide elected officers.
yes_meaning: Adopts the revised recall election process for statewide officers.
no_meaning: Keeps the current recall election process.

title: Proposition 37: Loan Program for Middle-Income Buyers of Qualified New Homes
summary: Initiative statute. Creates a state loan program to help middle-income buyers purchase qualified newly built homes.
yes_meaning: Creates the state home-buyer loan program.
no_meaning: No such loan program is created.

title: Proposition 38: Authorizes Bonds for Immunology Medical Research
summary: Initiative statute. Authorizes state bonds to fund immunology medical research.
yes_meaning: The state may sell bonds to fund immunology medical research.
no_meaning: No such research bonds are authorized.

title: Proposition 39: Requires Government-Issued Identification to Vote
summary: Initiative constitutional amendment. Requires voters to present government-issued identification in order to vote.
yes_meaning: Voters must present government-issued ID to vote.

title: Proposition 40: Imposes One-Time Tax on Certain Taxpayers
summary: Initiative constitutional amendment and statute. Imposes a one-time tax on certain high-wealth taxpayers.
yes_meaning: Imposes the one-time tax on the specified taxpayers.
no_meaning: No such one-time tax is imposed.

title: Proposition 41: Prohibits New State Taxes That Exclude Revenues from the State Spending Limit; Requires Audits for New Special Taxes
summary: Initiative constitutional amendment. Bars new state taxes that exclude their revenue from the state appropriations (spending) limit and requires audits of new state special taxes.
yes_meaning: Bars such spending-limit-excluded taxes and requires audits of new special taxes.
no_meaning: Keeps current spending-limit and audit rules.

title: Proposition 42: Prohibits New State Personal Property Taxes and Certain Retroactive State Taxes
summary: Initiative constitutional amendment. Bars new state personal property taxes and certain retroactive state taxes.
yes_meaning: Bars new state personal property taxes and certain retroactive taxes.
no_meaning: Keeps current state authority over such taxes.
